changes.detail: databaseHealth listed primary keys and unique indexes among the indexes nothing uses, since no query had read them; they enforce a rule on every write and can never be dropped. They are left out now, and the rest are ordered largest first, which is where dropping one saves the most.
changes.summary: Unused indexes no longer include primary keys and unique constraints, and the largest come first

changes.detail: Every route window now keeps a latency histogram (`latency_buckets`: 10ms to 10s, log-spaced, then one for anything slower), merged bucket by bucket when two processes flush the same window. `routeLatency` reports `p50Ms`, `p95Ms` and the previous period (`previous: { calls, p95Ms }`); `routeTrend` adds `p95Ms` per hour; slow-route problems are judged on p95 (`slowRouteP95Ms`, default 1000ms), falling back to the mean only for windows written before the buckets. `histogramQuantile`, `mergeHistograms` and `LATENCY_BUCKETS_MS` are exported. Applications that own the schema add `latency_buckets integer[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'` to `route_latency_windows`.
changes.summary: Route latency reports p50 and p95 from per-window histograms, with the previous period, and slow routes are judged on p95
startResourceTiming accepts a transport (and onTransportError) so a host can send resource batches through its own acknowledged outbox; sendBeacon stays the default
